fullDescription: The supplied proposal lists 3-star accommodation, itinerary meals, transfers, entry tickets, and an e-Visa. Flights, taxes, early check-in, late checkout, and tips are excluded. Confirm current availability, route details, and final inclusions before booking.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi
itinerary.text: Arrive in Hanoi, transfer to the hotel, and settle in before your first overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Sapa and Cat Cat Village
itinerary.text: Travel to Sapa and join a guided walk through Cat Cat Village and its surrounding landscapes.

itinerary.title: Fansipan and return to Hanoi
itinerary.text: Take the cable car toward Fansipan, explore the summit area, and return according to the confirmed transfer plan.

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay day cruise
itinerary.text: Join a shared cruise through Ha Long Bay, with lunch and activities as listed in the confirmed itinerary.

itinerary.title: Departure from Hanoi
itinerary.text: Check out and take your private transfer to the airport for your onward journey.
